editorial:
Imagine feeling like someone is always watching you, even when you are alone in your own home. That is exactly what happens in this creepy ride. You follow a woman whose life turns into a total nightmare when a mysterious man starts stalking her every move. The vibe is super tense from the start, making you feel the same panic she does. It is not just about jump scares; it is about that sinking feeling in your stomach as you realize the bad guy is closer than she thinks. You will find yourself rooting for her to find a way out before it is too late.

What really works here is how the tension builds up slowly until it finally explodes. The acting is solid, and the twists keep you guessing until the very end. While some parts of the plot feel a bit slow, the final act makes up for it with plenty of action. If you love stories about survival, you should definitely check this out. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. If you are a big movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your shelf is a great call.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, you find out the stalker was actually someone from the woman's past who blamed her for a tragedy. After a brutal fight in her house, she manages to trick him into a trap and kills him in self-defense. The movie ends with her sitting in the police station, safe but shaken. The final shot shows a photo of the stalker, revealing he had an accomplice who is still out there.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves survival stories and creepy mysteries.
